# RAR compatibility fixture

`rar5-default-external.rar` is the `m3_default.rar` test archive from
[rars v0.12.3](https://github.com/bitplane/rars/tree/v0.12.3/crates/rars/tests/fixtures/rar50),
published under Apache-2.0. SHA-256:
`3029e7d1a03e9afaf9d5384caa929cf1fe10165e8b15e38a6e509364a300ad59`.
It exercises an existing RAR5 archive with extra metadata and is never modified
in place by the tests.
